payload.name: Exhaustive shared-item retrieval after partial overlap
payload.description: When a question asks for all items two or more entities share and the initial search returns some but not all items, continue expanding with candidate items before answering.
content: If a question asks for all items that two or more entities share (e.g., games, movies, activities) and the first search returns some shared items, do not answer yet; treat the retrieval as incomplete.

Extract candidate item names from the retrieved memories, including preferences, recommendations, and event memories, and run follow-up searches pairing each candidate with each entity and relevant shared-activity verbs (play, watch, enjoy) to confirm whether it is also shared.
Include an item in the answer only if a retrieved memory explicitly links it to all entities; continue until follow-up searches return no new candidate items or only irrelevant memories.

solves: Agent answered after one combined search returned a partial set of shared games, omitting a memory listing another game played together. The reusable mechanism is that multi-entity list questions require exhaustive enumeration: partial overlap is not evidence of completeness. Applies to any future question asking for all shared items (games, movies, activities, places) between two or more entities when initial retrieval surfaces only some candidates.
